span.p:
Gather: 10 parallel searches
Reddit, HN, Indie Hackers, Quora, LinkedIn, X
G2, Capterra, Trustpilot, app stores
vendor forums, job boards, GitHub

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Stage A: extract pain points
(problems only), cluster by industry,
workflow, user and function,
score on 10 dimensions

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
2 or more independent
sources per cluster?

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Stage B, per cluster in parallel:
existing solutions, failure analysis,
white space, suggested startup,
8 validation scores

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Code checks:
quotes verbatim, competitor names
must appear in sources,
market size = customers x price

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Code computes:
evidence strength, confidence,
opportunity score, rank
= opportunity x evidence x market
